description: Canonical registry of Skill Madness lifecycle hooks. The run-with-flags wrapper and lint-hooks.sh read this file. Profiles gate which hooks fire; only qa-gate blocks.

hooks.description: Validate qa-report.json against the QE schema and apply orchestrator gate rules; BLOCK the Stop on a gate failure.
Format the file just touched by Edit/Write if a matching formatter is on PATH; never blocks.
Inject a short CLAUDE.md / .claude/profile.yaml summary (<=8 KB) into the session context.
On a Bash 'git commit', run lint-skills.sh if skills changed; warn only, never blocks the commit.

On a Bash 'git commit', if the skill catalog (counts across README/CLAUDE/PLAN/START-HERE/plugin.json/marketplace.json + the plugin.json skills array) has drifted from disk, run catalog.sh --sync and re-stage the corrected files so the commit stays self-consistent; acts only on real drift, never blocks.
Coarse, best-effort skill-usage emitter: on a Skill-tool call, append one outcome:unknown telemetry event via skill-health.sh record; degrades silently and never blocks.
